facts.statement: IFSCA circular IFSCA-DTFA/1/2025 dated 8 April 2025 supersedes 5 earlier fee circulars and defines 8 fee categories: Application, Licence/Registration, Flat Recurring, Conditional Recurring, Activity-based, Processing, Late, and Informal Guidance fees.
facts.detail: Fees are reviewed/revised once every 3 years.

facts.statement: The licence fee must be paid within 15 days of the in-principle approval intimation; late dues attract simple interest of 0.75% per month and late return filing attracts USD 100 per month per default, with a part month treated as a full month.

A relaxation processing fee of USD 2,500 applies, a substantive modification costs 20% of the licence fee, and a KMP change approval fee is USD 250 (or the Schedule-I amount if lower); mere intimation of a KMP appointment or resignation carries no fee.

The Informal Guidance fee is USD 1,000; for a non-compliant application USD 250 is retained as processing fee and USD 750 refunded. No fee is refundable under any other circumstance (withdrawal, surrender, revocation).

Schedule-I IBU fees: application USD 1,000 and licence USD 25,000; conditional recurring fees by turnover are USD 50,000 (up to USD 1 billion), USD 100,000 (USD 1-5 billion), USD 150,000 (USD 5-10 billion) and USD 2 million (above USD 10 billion).

Stock exchange recognition fee is USD 25,000 with renewal USD 1,000; conditional recurring fees scale from USD 1,500 (turnover up to USD 1.5 billion) through USD 15,000 (USD 1.5-15 billion), USD 75,000 (USD 15-75 billion), USD 150,000 (USD 75-150 billion) to USD 150,000 plus 0.000024% of excess above USD 150 billion.
Authorised FME registration fee is USD 5,000 with USD 2,000 recurring; Registered FME (Retail) registration is USD 10,000; Family Investment Fund registration is USD 15,000.
The broker-dealer activity fee is 0.00010% of monthly turnover.
FinTech authorisation fees: application USD 1,000 and authorisation USD 2,500; sandbox fees are application USD 500 and Limited Use Authorisation USD 1,000.

GIC registration fee is USD 12,500 with employee-based recurring fees of USD 7,500 (<500 employees), USD 10,000 (500-1,000) and USD 12,500 (>1,000); BATF registration is USD 5,000 with recurring USD 5,000/7,500/10,000 across the same employee bands.

IIO registration fee is USD 5,000 with an annual fee of the higher of USD 11,500 or 1/20th of 1% of gross premium written; an IIIO broker pays application USD 500, registration USD 1,000 and annual USD 2,000.
Indian applicants may pay application and registration fees in INR to the SBI account (IFSC code SBIN0060228) converted at the RBI reference rate.
